Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix\(mamba2\): Address model collapse with explicit ENTRY/EXIT heads

Critical fixes for Mamba2 model collapse \(constant outputs\):

1. Explicit ENTRY/EXIT Heads \(condor_brain.py\)
   - CondorExpertHead outputs 10 params \(was 8\)
   - entry_logit \(idx 8\), exit_logit \(idx 9\) as raw logits
   - No longer derived from confidence scalar

2. Realistic Training Targets \(train_condor_brain.py\)
   - Targets vary by IVR/RSI/ADX \(not constants\)
   - Entry/exit incorporate friction gate \(Rule #14\):
     - exec_allow, friction_ratio, gap_risk_score
   - Prevents model from learning constant 0.5

3. Anti-Collapse Loss \(condor_brain.py\)
   - Entropy regularization for probability heads
   - Variance penalty if batch output variance too low
   - BCEWithLogitsLoss for entry/exit supervision

4. Feature-Group Dropout \(condor_brain.py\)
   - New FeatureGroupDropout module
   - Drops entire feature groups \(15% prob recommended\)
   - Forces redundancy learning

5. Variance Monitoring \(training_monitor.py\)
   - compute_head_variance\(\) tracks per-head variance
   - check_variance_collapse\(\) warns if < threshold
   - Early detection of training collapse

6. Temporal Attribution \(export_learned_conditions.py\)
   - 7 temporal aggregations per feature
   - _last, _mean, _std, _min, _max, _last5, _slope
   - Better captures sequence model patterns

7. Training Script \(scripts/lightning_train_4runs.sh\)
   - 4 experiments for Lightning AI T4
   - Runs 1-2: No diffusion
   - Runs 3-4: With diffusion
   - 100K rows, d_model=512, layers=16

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
